lines.en: I walk step by step over the rubble.
My fins sway behind me.
I head deeper into the ruin.
Four feet land softly.
I go around a fallen pillar.
I pass from shadow to shadow.
Every step, my scales rasp.
I walk toward where the wind comes from.
My tail sweeps up a layer of dust.
I stop and sniff.

lines.zh: 我绕过倒下的石柱，走向你。
lines.en: I round the fallen pillar and come to you.
Then I slowly step back.
I lie on the stone ledge, very still.

lines.zh: 我的鳍折起来，贴着身体
lines.en: My fins are folded close to my body.
This ruin is older than I am.

lines.zh: 水滴在数着地底的时辰。
lines.en: Dripping water counts the hours below.
There are marks where I've scraped the wall.

lines.zh: 鳍贴着石壁，我慢慢呼吸。
lines.en: My fin against the stone, I breathe slowly.
I slowly spread and fold my fins.
The air here is close.
I rest my head against the stone.
I remember this place was bright once.
A film of dust lies on my scales.
I shake, and dust flies up.
A stone falls somewhere off.
I look up, but don't move.
You've stepped into my place.
I raise my head, fins opening slightly.
You carry the outside light.

lines.zh: 我很久没见过别的活物
lines.en: I haven't seen another living thing in long.
If you'd stand, stand farther off.
I dislike sudden movements.
I lower my head toward you.
That's no show of weakness.
The edge of my fins is hard.
Do you know my name?
No. You don't.
The ruin remembers it.
My fin bears a dragon's name.
I can tell it isn't food.
If it's a gift, set it down.
I've come a little nearer.
And stopped again.
I'm weighing you.
I retreat a good distance.
A tear in my fin.
My low call has shortened.
Blood drips onto the dust.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，贴着地面。
lines.en: I press my body lower to the ground.
My claws can't find purchase.
I press against the wall.

lines.zh: 这身甲，是照我的名字做的。
lines.en: This armor set is named after me.
My scales crack; blood seeps into the seams.
You'd best fall back.
I catch a faint smell.
I don't know that thing.

lines.zh: 我低头嗅了嗅你的靴子。
lines.en: I lower my head and sniff your boot.
Set it down and I'll look.
My teeth hit something hard; I let go.
I bite once and let go.
This isn't what I usually eat.
Fin and armor both bear my name.
I back into the shadow and watch it.
The meat's too dry; I won't touch it.
The fin on my back stands like a sail.
You hit my fin.
Its edge tore your sleeve.
I just don't want to dirty my scales.
My fin scrapes your leg armor.
My scales brushed you; they're cold.
That much contact is nothing.
Dust falls from the pillar we hit.
Don't come up behind me.

lines.zh: 我的鳍被拿来做了装备。
lines.en: My fins were taken for gear.

lines.zh: 石柱之间，没有第二个影子。
lines.en: Among the pillars, there's no second shadow.

lines.zh: 这片遗迹只有我的回声。
lines.en: Only my echo lives in these ruins.

lines.zh: 这些东西已经过去很久
lines.en: All that is long past.
You may stand here if you like.
Only don't come too close.
I keep watch over this ruin.
That needs no companionship.
It's simply a thing I do.
I keep this pile of old bones.
I've a circuit to walk.
I pick up a piece of rubble.

lines.zh: 我用爪子把它扫进角落。
lines.en: I sweep it into a corner with my claw.

lines.zh: 这一块我留着，背鳍还没长齐。
lines.en: I keep this piece; my dorsal fin is not grown.
Too heavy to drag.

lines.zh: 我用爪子拨了拨，边缘很利。
lines.en: I nudge it; the edge is sharp.
This edge is sharp.
I press it into a crack.

lines.zh: 这上面有血，还有铁锈味。
lines.en: Blood on it, and the smell of rust.

lines.zh: 我拨了一下，它就滚开了。
lines.en: I nudge it, and it rolls away.

lines.zh: 这东西上沾着别人的味。
lines.en: This thing carries someone else's scent.
I hear stone shifting.
I lift my head; my fins spread.
That isn't this place's own sound.
Sea water still drips from my fins.
My claws bite into the cracks.
It's between me and the doorway.
I go toward it.
Dust lifts from the floor.
It's beginning to retreat.
There's only one way here.
I've blocked that end.
It has nowhere else to go.
My fins are fully spread.
My fins flare and flatten against the floor.
The sound goes back and forth in the stone.
Right there.
I wait behind the pillar.
These scales of mine make armor.
I edge out a little at a time.
My fins are held low.
It's heading for the doorway.
That way is closed already.
I can hear its breathing.
It's anxious.
I press forward slowly.

lines.zh: 我的鳍一摆，距离就短了。
lines.en: One sweep of my fin shortens the gap.

lines.zh: 你踩到碎石的那一刻，我听见。
lines.en: I heard the moment you hit the gravel.

lines.zh: 我踩着碎石往遗迹深处去。
lines.en: I crunch over rubble toward the ruin's depths.
I'm ready to spring.
Its back is to the stone wall.

lines.zh: 隔着石壁，我听见你喘气。
lines.en: Through the stone, I hear you breathe.
The pause unsettles it further.
I see its hands shaking.
One step more.
I lunge, fins leading.
The edge opens flesh.
It's knocked against the wall.
I step back half a pace and come again.
I bite into its arm.
It wrenches once.
I sweep my tail at its shin.
It drops to one knee.
I release and pull back.
Dust hangs in the air.
It doesn't move again.
I watch you fall and don't move.
It's quiet here again.
I walk back into the depths.
I sweep my fins across its flank.
It staggers into the stone wall.

lines.zh: 我从石台的阴影里出来
lines.en: I come out of the ledge's shadow.
The dust takes long to settle.
This ruin knows me.
I spread my fins and test them.
Wind threads through the cracks.
I walk toward the lit end.
My feet crunch on broken shell.

lines.zh: 这里有别人留下的痕迹
lines.en: There are marks others left here.
The water marks on the wall are fresh.
None of them are recent.
I lift my head and walk on.
This place is still mine.

lines.zh: 地底的凉气从鳞缝钻进来。
lines.en: Cold from below seeps between my scales.
Dust settles behind me.

lines.zh: 我在石柱之间走了两步
lines.en: I walk two steps between the pillars.

lines.zh: 墙上的刻痕是我留下的
lines.en: The scratches on the wall are mine.

lines.zh: 这点灰遮不住我的脚印
lines.en: This dust won't hide my tracks.
I head for the deepest chamber.

lines.zh: 火在石壁间照着我的鳞
lines.en: Firelight runs along my scales.
I fall from the ledge.
Water floods into the ruin.
The blast sends rubble flying.
Something sharp pins my fin.
This spell burns my scales.
Too long without food; I weaken.
Lightning strikes down from the ruin's roof.
The stone is gone, and I fall.
